reuse.why: Extends the existing getBudgetData query and collapses the three copied visible-category queries into one helper; the goal_def parsing is a small new check rather than reusing goal-template's (unexported) template loading.

duplication.why: Removes three identical category queries, but the hidden/group-hidden rule is still written twice: in getFillableCategories' SQL and in copyPreviousMonth's own row check.

placement.why: Both helpers sit in server/budget/actions.ts beside the month-wide actions that use them.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and their category selection are touched.

maintainability.why: A named selection function makes the rule visible, but copyPreviousMonth applies the same rule through a separate path (budget rows plus inline hidden and template checks) that must be kept in step.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No pre-existing selection abstraction is bypassed; copyPreviousMonth iterates budget rows as before and calls hasSavedTemplates.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining hidden check in copyPreviousMonth is pre-existing and visible, not a reshaped copy.

one_place.where: setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg use getFillableCategories, but copyPreviousMonth in server/budget/actions.ts decides hidden/group-hidden itself and calls hasSavedTemplates separately, so the rule lives in two places.
